guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：IBM Heron 超導量子處理器
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor
guides.concept: 以可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制解析IBM Heron 超導量子處理器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor through tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識transmon 能階。約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 建立超導電路與非諧性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Heron 耦合圖。原生可用的雙位元連線限制編譯；SWAP 路由增加深度與噪聲暴露。 建立耦合圖與路由的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識微波控制線。控制脈衝的頻譜可同時激發鄰近模態；閘錯誤不只是振幅偏差。 建立微波控制與串擾的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較單獨與同時操作的假想錯誤矩陣。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識色散讀出鏈。讀出將位元狀態映射到共振器響應；混淆矩陣與相干誤差是不同證據。 建立色散讀出與指派誤差的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由標籤資料重算讀出混淆矩陣並保留樣本數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多溫層熱路。每條控制線帶入熱與雜訊；低溫層的冷卻能力需按溫度分開預算。 建立低溫熱路與訊號負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識邏輯錯誤證據。邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。 建立錯誤更正與邏輯證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify transmon levels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify heron coupling graph in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Native two-qubit connectivity constrains compilation; SWAP routing increases depth and noise exposure. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of coupling graphs and routing, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify microwave control lines in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Control spectra can excite neighboring modes; gate error is not only amplitude error. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microwave control and crosstalk, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dispersive readout chain in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Readout maps states to resonator response; a confusion matrix differs from coherent-error evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of dispersive readout and assignment error, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate a labeled readout confusion matrix with sample counts. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify multistage heat paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cryogenic heat paths and signal loads, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify logical-error evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of error correction and logical evidence, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交多溫層熱路的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交邏輯錯誤證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交邏輯錯誤證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for multistage heat paths.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for logical-error evidence.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for logical-error evidence.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：增加物理位元必然降低邏輯錯誤。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: More physical qubits necessarily reduce logical error.

related.title: Google Willow 表面碼系統
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制；Google Willow 表面碼系統改以碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control; Google Willow surface-code system centers on code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照transmon 能階與Willow 非諧能階，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Google Willow 表面碼系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以邏輯錯誤證據為起點，設計一項能區分「可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制」與「碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare transmon levels with willow anharmonic levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Google Willow surface-code system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from logical-error evidence and propose an observation distinguishing tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control from code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics, including uncertainty.
